ambient_events: Something paces the Feral Yard's perimeter just out of sight, patient, unhurried, closing.
A chorus of wrong-pitched howls goes up across the yard and is answered from every side.
description: A yard where the packs den — the fast, four-legged, wrong-eyed things the Redline makes of what were once dogs, and of what were once other things. They hunt in the open here because here, at last, they are the ones being avoided.
name: Feral Yard
